correctedFinding.basis: Directly inspected full-page PDF page 1 and enlarged q02.png. The 80-degree angle is at D; F is 60 degrees; therefore E is 40 degrees. Correspondence is A↔D, B↔F, C↔E. Options 1–4 are true; BC corresponds FE rather than ED, so only option 5 is false.
